text:
HELICANUS:
  If you want to know more,
  about why he would leave without asking your leave, out of love for you,
  I'll shed some light on it.
  While he was at Antioch—
THALIARD:
  (Aside.)
  What's this about Antioch?
HELICANUS:
  Royal Antiochus took offence at him, for what reason I don't know.
  At least, that's what he believed.
  And fearing he'd made a mistake, or done some wrong,
  he chose to punish himself to show how sorry he was.
  So he's taken on the hard life of a sailor,
  where every minute could mean life or death.
